End Cap Seal (Blind Cap)

A plug-type seal that completely closes a housing bore with no shaft passing through. A steel cup coated with rubber is press-fitted into the bore like an oil seal, and is used to close holes in gearboxes, reducers, pumps and more. Sizes are given as outer diameter (A) × width (B).
en.<p class=\"diagram-caption\">조립·설치도(왼쪽)와:
Installation drawing (left) and section dimensions (right)

A (outer diameter) = housing bore diameter, bore tolerance H8 · B (width) ±0.2 · installation depth B+0.5 · bore entry chamfer 10°–20° — these match the A and B columns in the table. As a closed type with no shaft passing through, there is no bore (d).

エンドキャップシール(盲栓)

軸が通らないハウジング穴を完全にふさぐ栓型のシールです。鋼板カップにゴムを被覆し、オイルシールと同様に穴へ圧入して、ギヤボックス・減速機・ポンプなどの穴ふさぎに使用します。規格は外径(A)×幅(B)で表記します。

端盖油封(堵盖)

用于完全封堵无轴穿过的壳体孔的堵盖型油封。在钢板杯外包覆橡胶，像油封一样压入孔中，用于齿轮箱、减速机、泵等的孔封堵。规格以外径(A)×宽度(B)表示。
